cause: Nothing on inf-bronze-runner blocks the raw files. The recovered bronze runner ran infra/aws/ec2/inf-bronze-runner/inf-bronze-fetch.sh:105-109 (orchestrator.py --mode daily) to a success sentinel on 2026-09-28. The raw jsonl.gz files are written by the gold chain (data/inf/scripts/gold/orion-gold-dispatch.sh:293-297, run order at data/inf/scripts/gold/orion-gold-dispatch.sh:348), which was aborted at its 3rd step INF_API_SILVER_REPS before reaching INF_API_PULL_TXN, INF_API_PULL_PERF or INF_API_PULL_POSITIONS_DAILY. That step runs convert_orion_api_to_silver.py, which imports data/inf/scripts/silver/_orion_api_silver_lib.py, whose line data/inf/scripts/silver/_orion_api_silver_lib.py:284 is 'from lib.silver_ids import DEFAULT_SILVER_ID_COLS, coerce_silver_ids'. The repo moved that implementation into lib/silver_ids.py (commits 8cd218cd05 and 4fc07eb397, 2026-09-28 03:10-03:13 -0400) and the changed _orion_api_silver_lib.py was deployed to s3://opal-data-inf/code/silver/ at 2026-09-28T07:17:53Z, but lib/silver_ids.py was never uploaded to any code/ prefix the gold runner syncs (data/inf/scripts/gold/orion-gold-dispatch.sh:545 lists code/gold/, code/manual_api/, code/silver/, code/bronze/; HeadObject 404 on code/gold/lib/silver_ids.py, code/lib/silver_ids.py and code/silver/lib/silver_ids.py). At 11:34:42Z the chain raised ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'lib.silver_ids', the dispatcher exited 1 (data/inf/scripts/gold/orion-gold-dispatch.sh:996, CHAIN FAILED at INF_API_SILVER_REPS) and no raw file landed. It is a half-landed deploy (a dependent file deployed without its new dependency), not a launch, lock, date-guard or sentinel effect: 2026-09-27, before that deploy, ran the identical launch pattern and landed all three files. It recurs daily: 2026-09-29 failed identically. Not established from here: where the runner's own 'lib' package (which the error text implies exists) lives on disk -- irrelevant to the missing module, but unread.
